Network Methodology Notes

Founders Ministries 365 listed

Founders Ministries publishes a vetted "Founders Friendly" directory at founders.org. Each listed church voluntarily affirms the 1689 London Baptist Confession + complementarian polity. Vetting strength: HIGH.

9Marks Church-Search 839 listed

9Marks publishes a Google-Maps backed church-finder at 9marks.org/church-search. Listings are user-submitted; 9Marks editorial staff does NOT individually vet entries. Treat inclusion as a self-attested signal of alignment with the 9 Marks (expositional preaching, congregational polity, complementarianism, biblical church discipline, meaningful membership, etc.) — not a 9Marks certification.

TGC Church Directory 1195 listed

The Gospel Coalition publishes an open self-listing Church Directory at thegospelcoalition.org/churches. ~52% of listings carry no formal network affiliation; the rest declare Acts 29, SEND Network, Harbor Network, Converge, or Redeemer City to City. Directory presence does NOT imply TGC Foundation Documents vetting; verify complementarianism + inerrancy independently.

Acts 29 493 listed

Acts 29 vets each church-planter through a residency before granting network membership. Distinctives: gospel-centered, Reformed soteriology, complementarian, missional church-planting, Spirit-empowered. Mark Driscoll was expelled in 2014; current leadership emphasizes accountability + elder plurality. Vetting strength: HIGH.

Sovereign Grace Churches 109 listed

Sovereign Grace Churches requires confessional alignment with SGC's Statement of Faith and Polity for membership; tracked via the SGC office. Distinctives: doctrines of grace, continuationist (open to charismatic gifts within an orderly worship frame), complementarian, gospel-centered church-planting. Vetting strength: HIGH.

Pillar Network 511 listed

Pillar Network (thepillarnetwork.com) is a church-planting and church-revitalization network headquartered in Wake Forest, NC. Members affirm shared doctrine and commit to plant or revitalize churches; partners with NAMB on certain plants. Vetting strength: HIGH.

Trinity Foundation Registry 39 listed

The Trinity Foundation publishes a screened Church Registry & Clearinghouse at trinityfoundation.org/churchapproved.php. Explicit disclaimer: "We are not establishing a new denomination." Each entry is vetted against confessional Reformed standards (1689 LBCF, Westminster Confession of Faith 1729, or Three Forms of Unity). Smaller in scope but highly confessional. Vetting strength: HIGH.
